configuration: Node24.19.0,Clang19.1.7 -std=c11 -O2; exact C wrappers/writers plus verbatim Lua5.4.8 option function; fixed typed raw-string/coordinate adapters. No Lua library dependency.
limitations: Three declarative option paths, each tested as table and positional API forms. Door state closed, ladder direction down, feature type tree. Two targets per form: valid keyword followed by NUL+suffix or NUL alone. Three controls per form: plain keyword, keyword+x, leading NUL+keyword. Twelve targets differ;18 controls match.

Fresh public solidfill ROOM setup, default map origin1,0, relative13,10→absolute14,10. D:1, no rooms/traps/stairs at the target before construction; ladder descends to D:2. Stop inside loader before finalization. No player/monster/object runtime or traversal.

C compiles the exact public lspo_door/lspo_ladder/lspo_feature wrappers, shared l_create_stairway, get_table_option, relevant terrain writers, orientation and actual stairway_add allocation/linking. Initial all-ROOM map is a shared asserted public setup precondition; the full C level-initialization pipeline is not executed here.

Lua5.4.8 luaL_checkoption is included verbatim and compiled. Repository Makefile.top/build-recorder.sh pin that version; archive/full source/snippet hashes and license are included. Typed stack/string adapters preserve the complete decoded byte allocation, including suffix. Actual C strcmp in the upstream option function determines prefix behavior. No Lua VM, arbitrary runtime, new installation or external library dependency.

Fixed coordinate adapter asserts the explicit interior coordinate and null room before applying origin1,0. Table integer/absent-flag readers implement only the fixture contract; random state/coordinates, room-wall doors, traps and nonladder stairs abort. Numeric/function-valued inputs, nil/defaults, non-ASCII strings and other keywords/APIs remain untested.

Output compares acceptance, terrain type, door mask, ladder direction, orientation, SpLev_Map marking and stair count; actual C/JS stair records also assert coordinate, ladder/down flags and destination. Error text, stack diagnostics and process behavior are not compared. Rejected controls are parser-boundary checks, not invalid-setup negatives.

This is one extension of the existing C-string-prefix cause, not three independent repairs. It is distinct from the queued required/optional map-character reader paths. Main owns implementation and deduplication. Supported API behavior is established for these fixtures; shipped exposure and score relevance are unknown.
